# Gnirehtet external dependency

JustRun does not bundle Gnirehtet binaries or the Android APK in the source
repository or packaged resources. Install Gnirehtet from its official release
and configure the executable path in JustRun Settings.

- Source: https://github.com/Genymobile/gnirehtet
- Releases: https://github.com/Genymobile/gnirehtet/releases
- Upstream license: Apache-2.0

Downloaded archives, `.exe`, and `.apk` files are intentionally ignored by
Git. Review the upstream release license and checksums before using them.
